The taste is genuinely impressive, especially for non-veg dishes. We tried:

Drums of Heaven – ⭐⭐⭐⭐absolutely super tasty, perfectly cooked and flavorful.

Chicken Kolhapuri – ⭐⭐⭐decent in taste with good spice balance.

Paneer Kolhapuri – ⭐⭐⭐⭐ surprisingly awesome, rich gravy and well-cooked paneer.

Garlic Naan & Tandoori Roti – ⭐⭐⭐⭐soft, fresh and paired really well with the gravies.

Steam Rice – ⭐⭐⭐fresh and perfectly cooked.

Price & Quantity:
The price and quantity are totally worth it. Portions are generous, and for the taste they serve, it feels value-for-money.

Staff & Service:
The staff was really good and polite. Service was quick and they made sure we got everything on time.

What Could Be Better:
The only drawbacks are the hygiene and seating area, which need improvement. Also, parking is a big issue since there is no dedicated parking space, making it a bit difficult to manage during rush hours.

Overall:
If you’re looking for tasty food—especially non-veg—Aman Dhaba is definitely worth a visit.
